name: CreditCovers
technicalDescription: Mirror, read-only in the app (in Saar's spec: credit_covers). One row per credit-insurance cover of a customer at the insurer (בסס״ח / ICIC). Replaces the old insurance fields on Customers (creditInsurer, insurerCaseNumber, insuranceApprovedAmount). A customer is insured when it has a cover with status תקף; the customer card's אובליגו וביטוח tab exists only for customers with a cover. Today filled by test fixtures only; the Priority / ICIC sync is a gap. Never written by the app's logic.

columns.name: coverNo
columns.description: Cover number at the insurer (sent as ORIG_COVER_NO on an increase request)

columns.name: validUntil
columns.description: Cover valid until (empty = no expiry known)

columns.name: coverSource
columns.description: Where the cover data comes from

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: priority-api, icic (CreditCovers only) or test-fixture (marked test data, removed by DeleteTestFixtures). Writers must set it

columns.name: syncedAt
columns.description: When this row was last synced
